Sword & Shield series · DAA

Darkness Ablaze

Released August 14, 2020 · 201 cards

Expanded

Darkness Ablaze is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on August 14, 2020. Its main set has 189 cards, plus 12 secret rares numbered beyond the set (201 in total). It includes 172 Pokémon, 25 Trainer and 4 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

76 illustrators worked on Darkness Ablaze. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (20), Shin Nagasawa (7), kirisAki (6), aky CG Works (5), Kouki Saitou (5), Masakazu Fukuda (5), Misa Tsutsui (5), Akira Komayama (4).
